system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Memorystore Redis instance (Basic tier, 1 GB) for application caching.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Memorystore Redis instance (Basic tier, 1 GB) for application caching.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: redis-instance.jinja

resources:
  - name: app-cache-redis
    type: redis-instance.jinja
    properties:
      instanceId: app-cache-redis
      region: us-central1
      zone: us-central1-a
      tier: BASIC
      memorySizeGb: 1
      redisVersion: REDIS_7_0
      displayName: Application Cache Redis
      authEnabled: true
      transitEncryptionMode: SERVER_AUTHENTICATION
      connectMode: PRIVATE_SERVICE_ACCESS
      authorizedNetwork: projects/$(ref.project-id)/global/networks/default
      reservedIpRange: 10.0.0.0/29
      maintenancePolicy:
        day: SUNDAY
        startHour: 3
        startMinute: 0
      redisConfigs:
        maxmemory-policy: allkeys-lru
        notify-keyspace-events: Ex
      labels:
        environment: production
        purpose: application-cache
        managed-by: deployment-manager

outputs:
  - name: redisHost
    value: $(ref.app-cache-redis.host)
  - name: redisPort
    value: $(ref.app-cache-redis.port)
  - name: redisCurrentLocationId
    value: $(ref.app-cache-redis.currentLocationId)
  - name: redisAuthString
    value: $(ref.app-cache-redis.authString)
